opportunities.title: Open Call for Expression of Interest: Experts to Serve on the Technical Committees of the African Medicines Agency
opportunities.description: Date of Issue: 11 May 2026 Closing Date for Applications: 18 June 2026 The African Medicines Agency, established under the AMA Treaty adopted by the African Union, is a specialised continental regulatory agency. The main objective of AMA is to enhance the capacity of State Parties and Regional Economic Communities (RECs) to regulate medical products in order to improve access to quality, safe, and efficacious medical products across the continent. In accordance with Article 20 of the AMA Treaty, the Agency is mandated to establish permanent or ad hoc technical committees to provide technical guidance on specific areas of regulatory expertise. In line with Article 21 of the AMA Treaty, the technical committees shall be responsible for carrying out scientific assessments and conducting scientific reviews of dossiers, including quality aspects and clinical trial applications; inspection of manufacturing facilities; and providing scientific opinions to facilitate the proper functioning of AMA. AMA Technical Committees provide scientific, technical, and regulatory advice to support the work of the Agency and contribute to strengthening regulatory convergence, scientific excellence, and access to safe, effective, and quality-assured medical products across Africa. opportunities.title: Consultancy to Scaling of the Africa CDC Continental Public Health Data Intelligence (HDI)
opportunities.description: The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) invites qualified firms to submit proposals for the Scaling of the Africa CDC Continental Public Health Data Intelligence (HDI). The service request for Phase 2 of the HDI platform is focused on enhancing and expanding the existing platform delivered in Phase 1, while preserving and reusing the current system architecture and investments. Duration: 6 months Location: Africa CDC, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia Submission Deadline: July 7, 2026, Submission Email: procurement@africacdc.org Interested firms are requested to submit their proposals in accordance with the requirements and instructions set out in the Solicitation Document. Interested bidders must demonstrate experience in delivering large-scale data platforms, deploying solutions on both on-premises and cloud environments (especially Azure), and implementing federated public health and AI-driven systems. They should have strong open-source expertise, experience working with governments and sensitive health data, and the ability to enhance existing systems incrementally while preserving Phase 1 investments. The Request for Proposal (RFP) document can be obtained upon request from the procurement contact. Phase 2 aims to enhance and scale the existing HDI platform to enable secure public health data sharing, advanced analytics and AI-driven disease intelligence, reliable performance in low-connectivity environments, and strong governance, privacy, and compliance
